SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period = 5
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    s.is_current,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS line_count,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.is_current
ORDER BY s.is_current DESC
